summary: Iteration 85 - Profile Page & Invite Org Filtering Testing Complete. All 7 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests verified Profile page functionality and InviteModal org filtering.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile page correctly displays Personal Information section with first_name, last_name, username fields
Email field is correctly disabled with 'Email cannot be changed' note
Change Password section has proper validation: passwords must match, minimum 6 characters
Profile update via PATCH /api/auth/profile works correctly and persists changes
Password change via POST /api/auth/change-password validates current password before allowing change
Duplicate username rejection works (400 response with 'Username already taken')
InviteModal correctly filters organisations by selected workspace (line 417 in Users.js)
Switching workspace in InviteModal clears previous org selections (line 381)
Invite endpoint stores org_ids on invitation record
Accept invite flow adds user to org member_ids (lines 3171-3176 in server.py)
User popover Profile link (data-testid='nav-profile') correctly navigates to /admin/profile
seed_data_creation: Test users created during invite acceptance tests are cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile page at /admin/profile is fully functional. Key data-testids: profile-page, profile-info-section, profile-first-name, profile-last-name, profile-username, save-profile-btn, change-password-section, current-password, new-password, confirm-password, change-password-btn. User popover Profile link: data-testid='nav-profile'. InviteModal org filtering works via workspace_id filter on orgs array (line 417 in Users.js). Password for johndoe@example.com remains User@123.
